architecture: x86_64 native syscall ABI only; reject x32/compat and unknown architecture
filesystem_guards: Readonly hashlisted root assets/nohostdata + privateboundedtmpfs. Deny-all fetcher/preflight prevents all URL/localresource interpretation even if trusted runtimefiles can be opened. No claim these proposals prove enforcement.
implementation: Maintained OCI runtime namespaces/cgroupv2/readonly mounts plus maintained libseccomp2.5.4 via a trusted initializer binding; no new C/native algorithm, engine fork or monkeypatch. Wrapper+supervisor must remain within500nonblanklines; not implemented here.
infrastructure_reuse: Inspected agent/automation/.github; no qualified reusable candidate-native worker policy identified. Reuse evidence/identity/byte/chunk validators; do not reuse trading credentials or imply ordinaryCI isolation qualifies this worker.

launch.UID: dedicated unmapped/nonprivileged worker uid; actual host/userns mapping must be qualified
launch.fds: close inherited descriptors except reviewed stdin/output/stderr/fixture; limit64; manifest actual inventory
launch.fixture: one synthetic readonly inheritedFD, UTF8/identity/hash/preflight checked; no filename/URL input to renderer
launch.output: bounded stdout/schema pipe and bounded stderr; combinedcap128MiB; no truncation accepted
launch.rootfs: exact private finalOCI digest readonly; no host/evidence/secret/buildcache/docker socket mounts

runtime_probe_dispatch: trusted immutable probe IDs supplied by supervisor as separate frozen tests; never interpreted from document and never pass hostile scripts through renderer

conditional_allow.condition: flags contain CLONE_VM|CLONE_SIGHAND|CLONE_THREAD; no bits beyond VM,FS,FILES,SIGHAND,THREAD,SYSVSEM,SETTLS,PARENT_SETTID,CHILD_CLEARTID,CHILD_SETTID; no exit-signal bits; cgroup.pids.max16

seccomp.default: SCMP_ACT_KILL_PROCESS; parent recordsSIGSYS rather than permitting ignoredEPERM

explicit_compatibility_deny.reason: deny all pointer-basedclone3; libc may use only filtered threadclone; never permit processcreation

seccomp.syscall_number_resolution: Resolve names and compile exact BPF through pinnedlibseccomp before gate; freeze actual BPF hash and kernel/OCI profile; these are unexecuted requirements
seccomp.unknown_or_late_native_syscall: fatal, retainreceipt and stop; do not add allow entries after observing candidate failure

stages: trusted supervisor creates bounded cgroup/namespaces/mounts, no evidence/credentials
trusted initializer verifies complete runtime/config/font/cache/oracle hashes and preloads exact permitted native imports; no document bytes read
freeze and verify descriptor/environment/thread/capability state; set hard resource limits and default-deny seccomp via maintained library
read only the already-passed syntheticFD after supervisor active-content/CSS/identity preflight; select constant normalworker mode, never probe/code mode from document
parent validates stage receipts/schema/byte accounting/caps, latches any error/limit/warning/fetch as failure; preserve all failure evidence
